source.soc_policy: Use only O*NET-SOC .00 base occupation rows; strip terminal .00 to SOC6. Do not average specialty profiles into a parent SOC.

semantic_rules.user_preference_meaning: The user explicitly prefers work in which the named activity is more important to occupational performance.

attributes.prompt: Would you like analyzing data or information to be an important part of your work?
attributes.rationale: Direct O*NET Work Activity match; kept separate from problem solving rather than blending two constructs.

attributes.prompt: Would you like making decisions and solving problems to be an important part of your work?
attributes.rationale: Direct O*NET Work Activity match on the Importance scale.

attributes.prompt: Would you like thinking creatively to be an important part of your work?
attributes.rationale: Uses the work activity rather than Originality ability or Innovation work style because the question is about creative activity being part of the job.
